messages:
Asha_parikh: Heads-up — NovaCare flagged as 'at-risk' in the renewal pulse. CSAT dipped after their last migration attempt; customer asked for more hands-on help. Can we set a focused enablement lab + office hours next week?
Liam_ng: Agree. Two things: get an agenda focused on their pain (migration + routing/cost) and offer an APAC-friendly slot. I'm flexible for Americas/EU.
Priya_Kumar: I can lead the migration lab portion and prepare a short runbook. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT.
Ken_Davis: I can cover smart routing & cost controls. Wed 11:00 PT works for me.
Asha_parikh: Proposed plan (draft agenda):
- 10m quick healthcheck + goals
- 30m migration hands-on (Priya)
- 25m routing & cost optimization demo (Ken)
- 15m action items + renewal next steps
If this looks good I'll split into two sessions: Americas/EU and APAC office hours.
Liam_ng: Let's do two sessions. Americas/EU: Wed 11:00 PT; APAC: Thu 4:00 UTC+8 (evening PT). I'll spin up a poll for availability.
Priya_Kumar: For the lab I'll need access details and a small dataset from the customer. Asha, can you request a pre-check with their infra lead?
Asha_parikh: Yep — pinged @NovaCare_Tech lead in email. Also adding a pre-session checklist: credentials, target model version, expected QPS, and any blocked flows.
Ken_Davis: I'll make a short deck on quant recommendations + routing fallbacks. Can someone add slides on cost impact (tokens vs reserved capacity)?
Liam_ng: I'll draft a 1-slide cost delta and drop in the shared folder.
calendar-bot: New event created: "NovaCare Enablement Lab — Americas" Wed 2024-05-15 11:00 PT. Invites sent to attendees and customer contacts.
cs_rotations_bot: Reminder: assign an owner for post-session follow-up and renewal outreach. Use tag #renewal-risk.
Asha_parikh: Owner: Ken will handle engineering follow-up and produce migration checklist. Priya will own lab materials. Liam will own CRM renewal flagging + docs.
Priya_Kumar: Also setting up a short feedback form to capture session quality and blockers: https://forms.redwood.ai/enab-feedback (share after session).
Liam_ng: Poll link for internal availability: https://doodle.com/schedule/redwood-novacare (placeholder). Please fill by EOD today.
Asha_parikh: I'll draft invites for both sessions and include the agenda + required pre-reads. Target: invites out by EOD so customer can confirm.
Ken_Davis: If we need a follow-up 1:1 with their platform engs, I'll schedule a focused office hour within 48h after lab.
Asha_parikh: Perfect. Thanks team — small ask: capture any blockers in the session notes thread and tag #renewal-risk so CS can surface to leadership.
Liam_ng: Will do.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "NovaCare Enablement Lab — APAC" Thu 2024-05-16 18:00 UTC+8.
Priya_Kumar: Confirmed materials folder: /shared/customer-success/novacare/enablement. I'll drop runbook + lab steps by EOD tomorrow.
Asha_parikh: Great. Closing plan: two sessions scheduled, owners assigned, poll live, feedback form ready. Will follow up with an internal dry-run on Tue. Thanks! :thumbsup:
